name: BALKRISHNA INDUSTRIES LTD
correction_2_26aug2026: Operator raised two defects against the 25-Aug delivery; a third was found while confirming them. (1) DATE: the file was dated 24 Aug 2026 though the correction pass ran on 25 Aug - renamed to '..._25 Aug 2026_Rating Rationale.md', header corrected, verify_bil.py repointed, stale 24-Aug file deleted. (2) COPIED FRAMING: the 25-Aug correction pass was made with ICRA's published rationale open (it had been supplied to diagnose the OPBDITA error) and carried across its Q1 FY2027 narrative and positive-sensitivity construction. The operator's standing instruction is that a shared agency report is REFERENCE ONLY - which is also CLAUDE.md section 2's rule. The rationale is rewritten end-to-end from BKT's own documents and this case's computed output. The copying was analytically costly, not just procedurally wrong: ICRA's framing said crude and currency hurt Q1 FY2027 margins, while BKT's own Q1 filing shows revenue +25.2% y/y and the company's own Reg 52(4) operating margin at 15.57% against 11.52% a year earlier - borrowing the conclusion displaced computing one. (3) UNSUPPORTED FIGURES: the report stated a 28.1% North America revenue decline (Rs 1,861.38 -> 1,338.48 cr), India growth of 24.0% (Rs 3,044.22 -> 3,774.36 cr) and a 70.1%/28.7%/1.2% replacement/OEM/other channel split, all attributed to the annual report. None is in the document set - every figure searched directly, plus 'north america', 'external customer', 'geograph' and an Ind AS 108 geographic-revenue note, zero hits across three annual reports and five quarterly filings. All removed; the absence is now disclosed in 'Any other information' as a scope limitation with the searches recorded (failure mode 20). THE RATING IS UNCHANGED at [ICRA]AA+ (Stable)/[ICRA]A1+ - it never rested on those figures, and the margin, leverage and coverage evidence supporting AA+ is untouched. The most serious element was in the gate ledger, not the report: G8 had encoded '28.1%' as a REQUIRED assertion, so the oracle would have passed the fabrication and failed the correction. G8 is abandoned with reasons and replaced by G8A, which also asserts the ABSENCE of all seven unsupported figures.
systemic_fix_26aug2026: Failure mode 37 added to CLAUDE.md with mechanical enforcement, per the section 8a meta-rule that no failure mode may ship as prose alone. check_sections.py probe 'No verbatim reuse of an agency publication' compares a draft against (a) agency-published texts in the case folder, detected by publisher footer signature, and (b) same-issuer files across all three reference libraries, matched on filename so the ~2,100-file corpus is not read wholesale. Figures are normalised out before comparison so two reports quoting the same audited number are not scored as copying - what is detected is shared SENTENCE CONSTRUCTION, at a threshold of 12 consecutive words, with mandated scaffolding (section headers, methodology names, the prescribed complexity-indicator paragraph, table rows, the KI source line) excluded. Verified with a positive control: two passages injected verbatim from ICRA_Actual_145208.txt are both caught and quoted; the rewritten report passes clean. Two false-positive classes were found and fixed BEFORE the probe shipped, because a checker that cries wolf trains the reader to ignore it - it initially flagged two consecutive mandated section headers across six reports, and matched 'JSW Steel' against Jindal Steel, Kalyani Steels, NMDC Steel and Manaksia Steels because a 4-character token floor discarded 'JSW' and left {steel} as the entire issuer identity (failure mode 24 from the other direction). On the corpus the probe now reports ONE report - Hindustan Aeronautics 07-Jul-2026, with 10 genuine shared runs including the headline, opening rationale sentence, outlook sentence and company-history paragraph - confirming the gap predates this case and is systemic.
rating_outcome: [ICRA]AA+ (Stable) / [ICRA]A1+; assigned - CORRECTED 25-Aug-2026, level with CRISIL and CareEdge (both AA+). First delivered as [ICRA]AA (one notch low) on a computation error: OPBDITA was built on the reported Other Expenses subtotal, which contained a Rs 290.01 crore FY2026 net forex LOSS, while the prior year's Rs 267.36 crore forex GAIN sat in Other Income and was netted out - an asymmetric build that understated FY2026 margin by 2.68 points and inverted its direction (computed -2.27pt vs the true +0.41pt). ICRA's actual published rationale (received 25-Aug-2026, the day after original delivery) confirmed AA+ and an OPBDIT/OI of 23.9%->24.3%, matching the corrected direction. This is BKT's FIRST ICRA rating - confirmed absent via a recorded zero-hit search for 'ICRA' across the FY2025-26 AR and the newest quarterly filing. Rated amounts marked 'to be confirmed by issuer' throughout - no ICRA primary rationale exists to import from under the five-condition amendment; ICRA's actual mandate (learned post-delivery) was a single proposed Rs 550 crore NCD, narrower than the bank-facilities/NCD/CP universe inferred here from peer-agency disclosure.
delivery_scope: Rationale + ratio engine (18/18 tie-outs reconcile) + ratio Excel (Financial_Spreads, 4 tabs) + Step 12 5-yr 3-statement model (5yr_Model.xlsx: Assumptions -> P_and_L -> Balance_Sheet -> Credit_Ratios -> Debt_Breakup -> Stress_Case, zero unresolved formula cells) + Step 12b scorecard (native Inputs->Scorecard->Rating template, sector=Auto components). check_sections.py PASS, all quality probes clean including the new 'Operating-profit normalisation stated' probe (failure mode 36). CONSOLIDATED basis (5 wholly-owned overseas subsidiaries carrying BKT's export/distribution operations). Key figures (CORRECTED): revenue Rs 10,823.08 cr (FY2026, +3.6%), PAT Rs 1,243.10 cr (-24.9%, a NON-OPERATING currency swing, not a margin decline), OPBDITA margin 23.93% (UP from 23.52% FY2025; 24.07% FY2024), gearing stable in a 0.31x-0.44x band across all 4 years despite a Rs 6,800 cr multi-year capex programme (~75% funded from operating cash flow not debt), interest coverage 19.39x FY2026 (never below 19x in 3 years). Step 12 model still shows the funding-gap arithmetic driving BKT toward net-debt-free by FY2028E, now with a flat ~23.3% forward margin assumption (not a compression-and-recovery arc that never happened).
method_notes: Two real defects were caught and fixed during the ORIGINAL build via mechanical checks, not assumed away: (1) compute_ratios.py's fabricated FY2022 balance-sheet column, caught by its own tie-out failing by exactly Rs 1,000 crore; (2) build_model.py's circular reference and over-steep capex taper, both fixed with evidence. A THIRD, more serious defect was caught POST-DELIVERY by comparing against ICRA's actual published rationale (25-Aug-2026): OPBDITA's other-income/other-expenses treatment was asymmetric - a forex loss inside Other Expenses was never added back, while the equivalent prior-year gain inside Other Income was correctly netted out - producing a materially wrong FY2026 margin (21.25% vs the true 23.93%) that inverted the year-on-year direction and cost a full rating notch (AA delivered vs AA+ actual). Root-caused by re-reading the exact Other Expenses note already in the document set (BALKRISHNA-INDUSTRIES-LIMITED_2025-26-1.md), which named 'Net Loss on foreign currency transaction and translation | 290.01 | -'. Fixed at three levels: (a) this case's compute_ratios.py/build_spreads.py/build_model.py/fill_scorecard.py all corrected and re-verified (18/18 tie-outs, 0 unresolved model cells, scorecard anchor AA with the divergence disclosed per Step 12b's AA+/AAA rule); (b) preflight.py probe [0c] AGGREGATE-NOTE CONTAMINANTS added, decomposing Other Income/Expenses notes before any ratio build and verified to surface exactly this Rs 290.01 crore line; (c) check_sections.py probe 'Operating-profit normalisation stated' (failure mode 36) added, verified to fire on the as-delivered (uncorrected) report and on 6 of 15 rationales in the existing corpus (ITC x3, HAL, Dhampur, Balkrishna), confirming the gap is systemic; the shared icra-ratio-engine ratio_template.py was fixed at the root with a symmetric other_expense_addbacks field. Two infrastructure bugs surfaced along the way were also fixed and verified: check_sections.py's detect_agency misdetected an ICRA report as CRISIL-formatted (re-verified against a full 14-report audit, no regressions), and verify_bil.py's own positive controls twice failed to actually inject a break (fixed both times, re-verified to genuinely reject the injected break).
